name: data.govmu.org — List of ICT Companies (CSV)
note: Open CSV, CC-BY-SA-4.0 (1,060 rows). Columns: Title, Address, District, Sectors, Other Related Sectors. Encoding Windows-1252 (cp1252). Sectoral (ICT) directory; no BRN/identifiers/status. No personal data.
